findings.evidence: `TauCeti.continuous_linearEquiv_iff` (GeneralLinearGroup.lean:91) has no `ContinuousMul` hypothesis and directly states continuity of `e ↦ ((e⁻¹ : V ≃ₗ[K] V) : Module.End K V)`; the orthogonal proofs at lines 53 and 63 only invoke the resulting base-change theorem and subtype continuity.
findings.fix: Remove `ContinuousMul` from both variable blocks and prove the inverse branch using `(TauCeti.continuous_linearEquiv_iff.mp continuous_id).2` composed with `LinearMap.continuous_baseChange`, instead of `continuous_inv`.
findings.issue: `LinearEquiv.continuous_baseChange` unnecessarily assumes `[ContinuousMul (Module.End K V)]`; this also forces the same excess assumption on both orthogonal continuity theorems at `OrthogonalGroup/BaseChange.lean:44`.

summary: The linear-equivalence theorem and both orthogonal specializations retain an unnecessary continuity-of-multiplication assumption.
